integrity: The proof is symbolic and uses the HOMFLY–PT-to-Conway specialization, standard smooth four-ball genus bounds for tau and Rasmussen s, and the classical fibered-knot Alexander degree theorem. The bundled finite script verifies only the arithmetic implications and is not used to justify the infinite knot-theoretic premises.
scientific_limitations: The result is a necessary counterexample obstruction for two conjectural inequalities, not a universal proof. Knots with positive Alexander genus defect remain possible counterexamples, and Alexander-sharpness is not equivalent to fibering.
title: Alexander-span defect obstruction for the HOMFLYPT–Floer candidates
